name: SonarCloud
tagline: Cloud code quality and security analysis for CI and pull requests
description: SonarCloud is a SaaS static analysis platform from SonarSource for continuous inspection of code quality and security. Its REST API exposes projects, measures, issues, quality gates, and analysis status so teams can automate reporting, gate checks, and dashboards in CI/CD.

auth.details: User token via HTTP Basic: token as username, empty password (Authorization: Basic base64(token:)). Generate tokens under My Account → Security.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: private projects up to 50k LOC, max 5 org members, unlimited public projects (main branch only). Separate free OSS plan: unlimited public repos, no private projects.
pricing.paid_plans: Team (from ~$34/mo, 100k–1.9M private LOC, unlimited members) and Enterprise (custom/annual, unlimited LOC ideal from 5M LOC, SSO/SCIM, portfolios, etc.). Priced by private LOC analyzed, not API calls. See sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing/sonarcloud/

rate_limits: not published (standard web API; no public per-endpoint RPS table found)
use_cases: list SonarCloud projects for an organization
fetch quality gate status for a project analysis
get code coverage or maintainability measures for a component
search open issues (bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells) by project
check latest analysis status before merging a PR
